source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
After this model shoots in your Shooting phase, pick 1 enemy unit, other than **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**, that at least 1 of those attacks hit. Until the phase ends, ranged attacks by friendly **DEATH GUARD** units that target the picked unit improve their Armour Penetration by 1.

This ability can affect each enemy unit only once per phase.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

effect.attacks: ranged attacks by friendly DEATH GUARD units targeting that unit
